title: Cleaner E3 Pedro ProPainter temporal plus observed references
body: CONFIRMED on the Pedro development clip, scene 2 only: official ProPainter ran locally on RTX 2060 for 46 frames at native 833x625 ROI padded to 840x632, FP16, without resize or fallback. The final conditioned composition used 82.23% E2 accepted observed pixels and 17.77% generated pixels within support. It preserved clean frames 144-147, changed zero pixels outside the authorized selection, and the FFV1 master matched composed PNGs with max channel delta 0. A mask omission, not a model hallucination, caused the frame-139 green residual; completing the already-overlapping chroma component added 420 pixels and removed connected green proxy components >=10 px. Weighted gradient on support was Golden 22.390, raw ProPainter 13.696, hybrid 20.288; this is descriptive, not a quality score. Visual critical-frame review passed structure provisionally, while temporal blind review, holdout, scene-0 window/fades, and commercial licensing remain open. ProPainter S-Lab License 1.0 blocks commercial promotion without permission.
